rule_hypotheses.rule: Payout = PM's final unpaid balance (ledger/statement balance due) minus excluded categories, after any cash security deposit or tenant credits the PM already applied, capped at Max Benefit.
Utilities (temp utilities, utility reimbursement, garbage) are excluded.

Late fees, SDRP/SD premiums, amenity/benefit packages and 3-day notice fees are excluded (enforced from ~late 2023 / 2024). The Sept-2023 approval for 215 paid the full balance incl. a 239.50 late charge and 79 of premiums, so enforcement was inconsistent early on.

Rent after lease end is excluded. Short holdover rent (3 days, 420) WAS paid in Dec 2023, so the exclusion may be later (2024 comments say 'no coverage for holdover rent after lease expiration') or may tolerate a few days.

The 'rent rounded up to next $500' cap is NOT applied universally. Approved amounts exceed it for 394 (750->1000 but paid 1500), 432 (1295->1500 but paid 1676.07) and 478 (1810->2000 but paid 3000). It holds trivially for small claims.

Max Benefit = waived security-deposit amount on the PM's SDRP addendum, rounded up to the next $500. Examples: 101 in-lieu deposit 1942.50 (=1.5x rent) -> 2000; 215 deposit option 2195 -> 2500; 478 lease 'Coverage $3,000' -> 3000; 818 'SDW1000' -> 1000.
Eviction claims with lost rent mid-lease are paid at Max Benefit (lost rent alone exceeds the cap).
Decline (0) when the tenant has no SDRP policy (traditional cash deposit, no Policy #/Max Benefit, lease predates program).
Decline (0) when the tenant paid/settled the balance with the PM (sheet Tenant Collection Status 'Collected Full Amount').
Decline (0) for short-term leases (initial term ~1 month).
Approved amount sometimes drops cents from the balance (2260.92 -> 2260); compare with a ~$1 tolerance.
Tenant collection settlements (Agreed Tenant Settlement / Collected Amount) are recovery after payment and do not reduce the Approved Benefit Amount.

Covered damage categories seen paid: carpet damage, lawn/overgrown grass, trash removal, garage remotes, wall repair, appliance cleaning, move-out repairs. Comments (stale row refs, so no tracking evidence) add caps: landscaping capped at 500; utilities capped at 150 for one PM per an April-2024 agreement; lease break = 1 month rent with no reletting fee; maintenance coordination fee excluded; first-full-month rent default -> decline.

extraction_lessons: Excalibur Homes (Alpharetta GA, 'TBR' codes) statements are chronological ledgers whose final 'Balance Due' is the claim. Damages post as 'TBR Damages to Property Charges' with free-text descriptions. 'YRIG Prem' + 'Sec Dep Ins Charge to Tenant' are the SDRP premiums. Rent after vacating is reversed by a negative 'TBR Rent Charge' line, so net it (215).

StarPointe/Propertyware ledgers are reverse-chronological scans (no text layer). Use rows labeled 'Unpaid Charge' plus 'Credit Memo' (SECDEP applied). 'Paid Charge' rows were already satisfied, and the Balance column is a running total read bottom-up (393).
Blue Fox 'Statement of Accounting' is a form (Credits / Deductions / Amount due from resident) with the vendor invoices attached behind it. Count the statement lines only, not the invoices too (252).

PURE CA 'Security Deposit Statement' lists charges by month with unlabeled add-ons (39 = Resident Benefit Program; 30/5/100 unlabeled). The first month's figure may be a remaining partial balance (1027.16) (488).

AppFolio tenant ledgers put Lease Expiration and Move-out in the header, useful for short-term-lease and post-lease-rent checks. The Gmail demand letter is a template with unfilled placeholders, so rely on the ledger (818).

Several folders lack any move-out accounting: 101 and 478 have only lease/addendum, 432 has only vendor invoices plus an addendum, 394 has only an eviction judgment. In these cases the Approved amount can't be itemized, so flag them as possible Drive bulk-download omissions.

The Comments sheet's 'Row N' references are stale (rows were re-sorted/inserted later) and don't map to current tracking rows. Match comments by date and amount instead. Example: the 01/26/24 comment '$1,676. No late charge, 3 day notice, amenity pkg or sd premium' sits on 'Row 364' but belongs to tracking 432 (approved 1676.07 on 2024-01-26).

Sheet fields disagree with documents fairly often: lease start (393: sheet 10/1/22 vs ledger move-in 9/7/22), rent (478: 1810 vs lease 1800), Lease End NaT (101, 215) when the lease has a clear end date, zip typo (432).

Some tenants have both a cash deposit and an SDRP/fee-in-lieu (393: $400 + $51/mo; 394: $300 + $33/mo). In 393 the PM applied the deposit to charges before the claim, and the adjuster paid the net balance.
Scanned PDFs needing vision in this batch: 252 statement, 301 renewal addendum, all 393 docs, both 394 docs. Tenant-contact JPG screenshots (215, 363) contain only PII.
Declines carry no itemization logic. Check eligibility first (policy present, short-term lease, tenant paid PM, late filing) before computing amounts.
